title: Empathy
learning_outcomes: Explain perspective-taking in the context of empathy.
Compare and distinguish reflective listening in the context of empathy.
Apply empathy versus agreement in the context of empathy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about compassionate limits in the context of empathy.

lessons.title: Perspective-taking
lessons.outcome: Explain perspective-taking in the context of empathy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving perspective-taking; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to listening role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain perspective-taking from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of perspective-taking; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Reflective listening
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish reflective listening in the context of empathy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reflective listening; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to listening role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reflective listening from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reflective listening; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Empathy versus agreement
lessons.outcome: Apply empathy versus agreement in the context of empathy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving empathy versus agreement; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to listening role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain empathy versus agreement from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of empathy versus agreement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Compassionate limits
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about compassionate limits in the context of empathy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving compassionate limits; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to listening role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain compassionate limits from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of compassionate limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of perspective-taking; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of reflective listening; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of empathy versus agreement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of compassionate limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
